verdict.rationale: Gusto documents API access to payroll records (GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls), a payroll.paid webhook that can trigger downstream processing, and payroll report generation. It also lists accounting software among its integration types and offers an official OAuth-scoped MCP server an agent can use to query account data. This gives an agent a plausible path to pull payroll data, but nothing documents a journal-entry or general-ledger export, account mapping, or a reconciliation workflow. Missing for 10: a documented payroll journal/GL export or endpoint, ledger account mapping, a documented reconciliation flow into an accounting system, and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven reconciliation.
